svg.title: Planned Raft leader failure and duplicate-result recovery
svg.desc: Coordinator A applies a committed completion to its durable queue then crashes before acknowledging the worker. The elected coordinator B commits a current-term no-op and applies the committed history to its own durable queue replica. Reading that queue detects a retry and preserves the accepted grid without counting it twice. Coordinator A can reconstruct its queue when it restarts.

text.tspan: The queue lanes are local state inside their coordinators.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: All three queue replicas are recoverable from their persistent Raft logs.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: A follower can store an entry before it learns that the entry committed.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: C may lag. A + B already form a majority.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: A crashes before the worker receives confirmation.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Its in-memory queue is unavailable, but committed history survives.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Heartbeats stop and randomized election timeouts elapse

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Scheduling continues from B's durable queue replica.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: PENDING work remains available and completed work stays completed.

text.style: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: The duplicate retry does not add another accepted result.
